subject: Q1 Budget Approval Required
body:
Hi Sarah,

I need your sign-off on the Q1 product budget:

- Engineering resources: $450,000
- Cloud infrastructure: $85,000 (pending vendor selection)
- Marketing: $120,000
- Contingency: $45,000

Total: $700,000

Please review and confirm by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Bob Martinez
Finance Director
